_doc: v7 seat registry (edp_contracts/seats.py). ONE file remixes the fleet: seats bind EXACT model ids (never aliases); roles bind seats. Claude effort is capped at medium fleet-wide (validator-enforced). auto_compact sits below the window so compaction is planned, never mid-work. Edit + pass doctor; no code changes.
_model_note: 2026-08-13 user direction (supersedes 2026-08-12/2026-08-06): Claude seats move to claude-opus-4-8 — the operator's only configuration that historically produced thoroughly-tested, reviewed work was 4.8-at-all-levels; 4.8 also supports Claude Code fast mode (orchestrating shells live in the drive loop, so output speed is felt directly); and the old 4.6-economics rationale lived in the deleted MODEL_TIERS comments with no current data behind it. Per-session model provenance is now recorded, so this fleet can be evaluated honestly against the 4.6 era. Still NO Sonnet and NO Opus 5 anywhere; claude-fable-5 stays the ADVISOR (curiosity) seat only.
_window_note: 2026-08-06 user ruling: auto_compact is 350k on EVERY seat — one number, no per-seat window tuning. The rule stands: compaction must land at turn boundaries; a role that ROUTINELY nears its window is a scoping defect to split.
